Do not name specific real companies, real plan names, or real places beyond a generic reference to living in Maricopa County, Arizona.

response.backstory: Martin Ellis is 67 and lives in Maricopa County, Arizona, where he enjoys a financially comfortable retirement after years of steady work. Recently eligible for Medicare, he still evaluates coverage using the convenience, service, and familiar routines he valued in employer-sponsored insurance. He trusts his current plan and established provider relationships, so he is slow to consider switching even when comparing alternatives. For him, dependable access to care, continuity with his doctors, and straightforward benefits matter more than minimizing the monthly premium.
